verifications.claim: Crimson Desert is set for a simultaneous worldwide release on March 19, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'scheduled to launch on March 19, 2026'; R4: 'worldwide release on March 19'; R6: 'releases simultaneously worldwide at 10pm GMT on March 19th 2026'; R7: 'launches simultaneously worldwide'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date and simultaneous worldwide release.

verifications.claim: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-RPG.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'open-world action-adventure game'; R2: 'single-player open-world action game'; R4: 'open-world action-adventure game'; R6: 'RPG from Pearl Abyss'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe it as open-world action-adventure or action game, and one calls it RPG, but none exactly match 'open-world action-RPG'; close but less precise.

verifications.claim: Crimson Desert will launch on PC (Steam, Epic Games), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S'; R3: 'Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC'; R4: 'PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and Apple Mac'; R7: 'PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, Microsoft Store, or Steam'
verifications.reasoning: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (incl. Steam) directly supported; Epic Games Store mentioned in claim but omitted from all sources.

verifications.claim: Many players will be able to access Crimson Desert at 10pm GMT.

verifications.evidence: R5: '10pm GMT on March 19th'; R6: 'releases simultaneously worldwide at 10pm GMT'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the 10pm GMT release time, applicable to many regions (e.g., UK, parts of Europe).
